title: 35. 내가 형아! 호야 지킴이!
titleT: 35. I'm the Big Brother! Hoya's Guardian!

pages.ko: "조심조심, 살살!" 아침부터 호리는 신이 났어요. 아기 동생 호야가 오늘따라 방긋방긋 잘 웃거든요. "호야야, 형아랑 놀자!" 호리는 두 팔을 활짝 벌리고 폴짝폴짝 뛰어요.
pages.t: "Careful, careful, gently!" Hori was excited from the moment he woke up. His baby sister Hoya was smiling and giggling so much today. "Hoya, let's play with big brother!" Hori spread his arms wide and hopped around happily.

pages.ko: 호리는 호야를 번쩍 안아 빙글 돌리려다 그만— 팔을 우악스럽게 콱! 잡았어요. "형아 힘 세지!" 그런데 호야 얼굴이 찡— 일그러졌어요. 너무 세게 잡혔거든요.
pages.t: Hori scooped Hoya up to spin her around, but he ended up—grabbing her arm hard, oops! "Big brother is strong, right!" But Hoya's face scrunched up in pain. He had grabbed her much too hard.

pages.ko: "으에엥—" 호야가 울음을 터뜨릴 것 같아요. 입이 삐죽삐죽, 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁. 호리는 깜짝 놀라 손을 뗐어요. "어… 호야야, 왜 그래? 형아가 아프게 했어?"
pages.t: "Waaah—" Hoya looked like she was about to burst into tears. Her lip trembled, and her eyes brimmed with tears. Startled, Hori let go right away. "Uh oh... Hoya, what's wrong? Did big brother hurt you?"

pages.ko: 엄마가 조르르 와서 호야를 먼저 폭 안아 달래 줬어요. "호리야, 호야는 아직 아기라서 살살 다뤄야 해." 엄마가 호리 손을 잡고 부드럽게 말했어요. "형아 손은 크고 힘이 세잖아. 조심조심, 살살!"
pages.t: Mom hurried over and hugged Hoya first to soothe her. "Hori, Hoya is still a baby, so you have to be gentle with her." Mom took Hori's hand and spoke softly. "Your hands are big and strong, you know. Careful, careful, gently!"

pages.ko: 엄마가 호리 손바닥에 자기 손을 살포시 얹었어요. "봐, 이렇게 깃털처럼 살살. 솜사탕 만지듯이." 호리는 자기 손을 가만히 내려다봤어요. "아… 아기는 이렇게 살살 만져야 하는구나!"
pages.t: Mom laid her hand gently on top of Hori's palm. "See, like this, soft as a feather. Like touching cotton candy." Hori looked down quietly at his own hand. "Oh... this is how gently I need to touch a baby!"

pages.ko: 호리는 바닥을 두리번두리번 살폈어요. 뾰족한 블록, 작은 구슬— 호야가 입에 넣거나 밟으면 큰일이에요! "이건 위험해!" 호리가 뾰족한 것들을 통에 쏙쏙 담아 저 멀리 치웠어요.
pages.t: Hori looked around the floor carefully. Sharp blocks, tiny beads—it would be terrible if Hoya put them in her mouth or stepped on them! "This is dangerous!" Hori scooped up all the sharp little things into a bin and put them safely away.

pages.ko: 이번엔 호리가 두 손을 활짝 펴서 호야를 아주 살포시 안았어요. 깃털처럼, 솜사탕처럼. "조심조심, 살살!" 호야가 까르르 웃어요. 세게 잡지 않으니 하나도 안 아프고, 훨씬 더 재밌어요.
pages.t: This time, Hori spread his hands wide and held Hoya ever so gently. Soft as a feather, soft as cotton candy. "Careful, careful, gently!" Hoya giggled happily. Without being gripped tight, nothing hurt at all, and it was so much more fun.

pages.ko: 호야가 딸랑이를 갖고 싶어 손을 뻗어요. 예전 같으면 호리가 먼저 뺏었겠지만, 오늘은 달라요. "호야 먼저 해. 형아는 기다릴게!" 그 순간 호리 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 다정한 형이 됐어요.
pages.t: Hoya reached her hand out, wanting the rattle. In the past, Hori would have grabbed it first, but today was different. "You go first, Hoya. Big brother will wait!" In that moment, the stripes on Hori's tail sparkled in rainbow colors—vroom! He had become a caring big brother.

pages.ko: 이제 호리는 형아 규칙을 알아요. 하나, 아기는 살살 만지기! 둘, 좋은 건 순서대로 양보하기! 셋, 위험한 건 얼른 치우기! 호야가 아장아장 걸을 때 호리가 손을 살포시 잡아 줘요. "조심조심, 살살!"
pages.t: Now Hori knows the big brother rules. One, touch the baby gently! Two, take turns and let her go first with good things! Three, quickly put away anything dangerous! When Hoya toddles along, Hori gently holds her hand. "Careful, careful, gently!"

pages.ko: 엄마가 두 형제를 한꺼번에 폭 안아 주었어요. "우리 호리, 이제 정말 멋진 형아네!" 호리는 호야 볼에 살포시 뽀뽀했어요. 크고 힘센 손도 살살 쓰면 세상에서 제일 다정해요. "조심조심, 살살!"
pages.t: Mom wrapped both her children in one big hug. "My Hori is truly a wonderful big brother now!" Hori gently kissed Hoya's cheek. Even big, strong hands become the gentlest in the world when used with care. Careful, careful, gently!

overview.ko: 동생 호야를 어떻게 대할지 몰라 서툴던 호리가 부드럽게 돌보는 형아가 되어 가는 가족 동화입니다.
overview.t: A family story about Hori, who was clumsy and unsure how to treat his baby sister Hoya, growing into a gentle, caring big brother.

lessons.t: Learn to care for a younger sibling gently.

readingTips.ko: '내가 형아, 호야 지킴이' 후렴을 자랑스럽게 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'I'm the big brother, Hoya's guardian' in a proud voice.
Talk together about being considerate to brothers and sisters.
